summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with docstring updates; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; reworked GridPatchDataset with patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float; numpy ceiling replaces math), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, test_missing_len). Not run: pytest, and the GridPatchDataset docstring example output is derived by reasoning, not captured. Open choice: set_determinism(1234) is called in setUp and again at the start of test_loading_array; both use the same seed, so the draws should match, but one can be removed if you want a single call. Edited modules have no lines over 120 characters except three pre-existing lines in get_valid_patch_size.
